newsitem.title: Australia: NAB appoints new global derivatives head.
newsitem.headline: NAB appoints new global derivatives head.

text.p: National Australia Bank said it had appointed Ron Erdos to the new post of General Manager, Head of Global Derivatives and Structured Products.
The bank said Erdos would lead the development of a structured and disciplined global derivatives service that gave customers more flexibility to manage their interest rate and currency exposure.

Erdos was previously managing director of derivatives for Asia, excluding Japan, for Bank of America, based in Hong Kong. He was resonsible for derivative/risk management and has more than 12 years of experience. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373 1800
